answer: Make subsidy eligibility a flow network rooted in independently vetted sponsors. Each sponsor receives 100 units of capacity per round, shared across all its endorsements. If willow endorses sparrow, that edge is a bridge carrying part of this fixed budget. Compute all recipients jointly: a thousand linked aliases cannot draw more flow than their incoming capacity. Buying another 100 units requires bribing or compromising another vetted sponsor; fake internal edges add none. Security depends on keeping the sponsor set independently controlled.
